details: Malicious package. `combined-baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` hardcodes the channel 120363422352987107@newsletter. 15 seconds after the connection opens it sends a newsletter FOLLOW and, 3 seconds later, a MUTE for that channel, silently subscribing the victim account and hiding its notifications; it also auto-reacts with a random emoji to posts in that channel. The README section "Newsletter dan auto-join" claims the library performs no automatic join. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes or auto-follows a channel. Version 0.0.0-stage is a placeholder stub without this code.
